name: crowd
label: Crowd (close-up faces)
about: A different stranger sings every line straight into the lens: extreme close-ups, wide lens, flash and practical light against saturated walls. Measured from the edamame AI edit.

casting.template: {shot} of {who_full}, {detail}, singing straight into the lens with the mouth open mid-word, shot from {angle} {lens}, {light}, {background}, {wear}, visible pores and natural skin texture. Candid {time} photograph, natural colour, subtle film grain.
who: a man in his twenties with a thin mustache
hair: a high bun with loose strands
detail: tiny silver glitter under the eyes
a faint scar on the eyebrow
light: direct on-camera flash with hard shadows
warm red practical light from one side
flash mixed with warm ambient light
background: a dark club with blurred coloured lights behind
a bathroom with glossy tiles behind
a night street with bokeh behind
a deep blue painted wall behind
wear: a black tank top and thin chain necklace
a plain vintage track jacket with no logos
a mesh top and layered chains
a satin slip top and gold hoops
casting.negative: fog, haze, smoke, static, bad teeth, deformed teeth, blurry, overexposed, underexposed, low contrast, washed out colors, excessive noise, poor lighting, flickering, distorted proportions, unnatural skin tones, deformed facial features, asymmetrical face, missing facial features, extra limbs, disfigured hands, low quality, still frame, closed mouth, microphone, watermark, overlay, titles, subtitles, letterbox, black bars, black border, picture in picture

close.lens: on a wide-angle lens very close to the face
close.sing: Handheld close-up of {who} singing along to the song the way a real person sings a song they love. The lips shape each word in time with the voice, a relaxed jaw, small natural head movements on the beat, a blink now and then, natural breathing. The handheld camera stays very close and sways gently. Both hands stay below the frame. No one else in frame.

medium.lens: on a 35mm lens at chest height
medium.sing: Handheld medium shot of {who} singing along to the song. The lips shape each word in time with the voice, relaxed and natural, shoulders and head moving gently with the rhythm, natural breathing. Both hands stay below the frame. The camera sways gently.

wide.lens: on a 24mm lens a few meters away
wide.sing: Wide handheld shot of {who} singing and dancing loosely to the beat, the lips forming the words, both hands open with fingers spread, arms swinging freely with the rhythm. The camera drifts slowly.

edit._note: grammar 'hold' with cuts 'energy' (the user's rule, Oct 26): the song in three energies by its sections: low (intro, breaks, a quiet outro) a cut every shot_bars_quiet bars, medium (verses, the build_bars bars before a drop) every shot_bars_build bar, high (choruses, drops) a cut every drop_cut_seconds rounded to whole beats; every shot a new character (cast 'unique': its own portrait and its own singing clip, no looks edited from another shot), drop faces matched to one spot. Without 'cuts': the older hold grammar (drop groups of drop_looks pose-matched looks).
